criteria.criterion: In xtask/src/site.rs, `pub fn render(study: &Study) -> Result<String>` keeps its signature but is no longer than 200 lines; Grep of the file shows new private `fn` helpers (one per section) called from render, and no function in the file exceeds 200 lines.
criteria.evidence: I read the file and used Grep for `^(pub )?fn |^\}`. `render` keeps its signature and runs from the fn token at line 241 to the closing brace at line 288. That is 48 lines by the rule in crates/athena-core/src/code_health.rs (note_fn: end - start + 1). It calls ten new private helpers in the original order: start_here, states, counters, transitions, rationales, glossary, findings, next_steps, claims_section and finish. The longest production function is now transitions (lines 386–447, 62 lines). Every other function is shorter. The test module is excluded from the measurement.

criteria.criterion: The diff touches only xtask/src/site.rs; the `mod tests` block is not edited except possibly imports, and no test is deleted or weakened (git diff shows no removed #[test] functions).
criteria.evidence: The diff changes xtask/src/site.rs and CHANGELOG.md. CHANGELOG.md is an expected deliverable. Every site.rs hunk is between lines 275 and 652, and the tests module starts at line 725. No #[test] function is removed or edited.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: all existing site tests pass unchanged, including the_real_study_renders_with_an_intro_and_glossary and the_page_cites_claim_ids_and_the_pinned_commit, showing the rendered HTML behavior is unchanged.
criteria.evidence: All xtask tests passed: 79 unit tests, including every site::tests case. the_real_study_renders_with_an_intro_and_glossary and the_page_cites_claim_ids_and_the_pinned_commit both report ok. The integration tests also passed: ci_shards 20, fingerprint 10, policy 22, site_page 5, spec 30 and walltime 6. Reading the diff confirms that no string literal or format string changed. Only how `body`, `known` and `github` are passed changed: `&mut body` became `body`, `&known` became `known`, and `github.clone().unwrap_or_else` became the equivalent `map_or_else`. Validation still happens in the same order, so error order and messages are unchanged.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`; both exit clean.
criteria.evidence: Athena's recorded checks for 37d847e5f618 (CI run 42676456439) report that `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` both passed.

criteria.criterion: Public items used by xtask/src/decisions.rs and main.rs (ATHENA_URL, CSS, DECISIONS_PAGE, escape, source_url, target_dir, default_out, check_out, load, build, render) keep their names, visibility and signatures.
criteria.evidence: The diff changes no line that declares these items. Its only signature-level change is new private functions inside what was render's body. render's signature line, line 241, is unchanged context. The crate compiles, and the decisions tests that use these items pass.

findings.summary: `finish` takes `&mut String` but only reads `body` after appending to it; it could take `body: String` by value.
findings.evidence: fn finish(body: &mut String, ...) -> String builds the page with format!("...{body}...") and returns a new String. The output does not change either way.

summary: The change passes. It splits the 333-line `render` in xtask/src/site.rs into ten private helpers, one per page section, called in the original order. By the code-health counting rule, `render` is now 48 lines and the longest production function, `transitions`, is 62, so the file is under the 200-line function limit. String literals, format strings and the order of validation are unchanged; only how arguments are passed changed. Public items and the test module are untouched. I ran `cargo test -p xtask` and all tests passed, including every site test. Athena's recorded fmt and clippy checks passed. CHANGELOG.md has an accurate entry. The one finding is a nit: `finish` could take `body` by value.
